overview.overview: Wisconsin remains one of the closest battlegrounds in the country, with 10 electoral votes and a history of razor-thin margins. The state voted Democratic in 2020 by a narrow margin and Republican in 2024 by an even narrower one, underscoring its status as a genuine toss-up. Wisconsin currently sits slightly to the right of the nation as a whole, and the expected margin here is modestly favorable to Republicans given the national environment.
overview.watch: A shift in the national environment of even a couple of points could flip Wisconsin, given its near-even recent margins and slight Republican lean.
key_factors: Wisconsin's margins in 2020 and 2024 were both under one point, making small shifts decisive
The state leans slightly Republican relative to the nation, so a neutral national environment still favors the GOP here
With no home-state candidates on either ticket, Wisconsin's outcome depends heavily on the national picture
